description: Train a deterministic classifier on engineered spatiotemporal pose features without any cross-example smoothing. For each sample (already containing the 7 temporal offsets at [-15,-5,-1,0,1,5,15]) we build translation- and scale-robust features from the two animals’ keypoints: distances (nose–nose, center–center, and minimum landmark distance across animals) at each offset; instantaneous separation change and approach speeds over ±1/±5/±15; individual nose speeds; head/body orientation cosines and their alignment with the inter-animal axis; head turning (cosine of angle change) over ±1 and ±5; intra-animal shape features normalized by body length (ear gap, hip gap, neck–tail, nose–tail, nose–to–center) for each animal; and several pair-centric projections (e.g., longitudinal offsets). Distances are normalized by the geometric mean of both animals’ body lengths at t=0. Inputs with NaN/inf are imputed per example using the mean across its 7 offsets (fallback to 0 if all NaN). A single HistGradientBoostingClassifier (no early stopping; fixed random seed) is trained on all training data with class-balanced sample weights (inverse-frequency). Predictions are class argmax for each target frame. No features are computed across example boundaries and no temporal smoothing of outputs is performed.
